Effect is the change in the chance of first place in percentage points (artifact fraction times 100). standard_error is simulation error over the 20000 paths only; the artifact stores no interval or probability_positive, and field-model uncertainty is larger than the simulation error. Not recorded: top-10 chance changes (a stated proxy with no dedicated unit), expected wins and expected rank changes (counts and ranks have no effect unit). Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the artifact; no new measurement.
pool07_u1_shares_weeks_5_8_trailing_tilt.plain_summary: Tests whether a pick policy that looks at our place in the standings changes our chance of finishing first in the pool, compared with always taking the most likely side.
